newsitem.title: USA: Indiana corn 97 percent planted, soybeans 81 pct.
newsitem.headline: Indiana corn 97 percent planted, soybeans 81 pct.

text.p: Indiana's corn seeding neared completion as of Sunday with 97 percent planted, well ahead of last year's pace of 41 percent and the average 73 percent, according to the Indiana Agricultural Statistics Service.
Soybean seeding was 81 percent complete, ahead of 14 percent a year ago and well beyond the average of 48 percent.
Winter wheat conditions stood at 71 percent good to excellent, compared with only 33 percent in that category the same week a year ago.
Forty-eight percent of the wheat crop was headed out, compared with 46 percent a year ago and 50 percent average.

Topsoil moisture was reported at 10 percent surplus, 64 percent adequate, 22 percent short and four percent very short. Subsoil moisture was nine percent surplus, 79 percent adequate, 11 percent short and one percent very short.
Pasture conditions were eight percent excellent, 53 percent good, 29 percent fair, eight percent poor and two percent very poor.
